folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B400: complete P5–P16 checkpoints and profile accounting
folds.body:
All P5–P16 checkpoints were read through their final completion/readback and remaining-gate sections. Their P1–P4 worktree-only/unmerged statements, initially absent reports, one-realm milestone, source fingerprints, ports and UI widths retain their dates. This owner's later merge and B145 caller qualification already supersede broad absence and native-randomness claims. These new checkpoint reads do not recertify that source, merge, browser or persistence evidence. Current AD36, AD42, AD51, AD52 and PROJECT govern; no old completed documentation lane needs a successor solely because an earlier progress paragraph says next.

P5 preserves sealed-candidate fairness as separate from mechanical exclusion scans. P6's eleven creation families distinguish actual product, knowledge, process, finite means and useful consumer. P7's grammar/people extension does not create autonomous labor or bridge every person into simulation. P8's deposit/yield/ecology/creature/supply/logistics contract does not supply a second material registry or PRNG. P11's eligibility, weights, quality and exposure can consume different context; actual truth and received evidence remain separate. Linked profile/source/implementation bodies are not newly read by checkpoint coverage.

P9's complete checkpoint reports39profiles. Its actual report inventory has39profile rows and40linked dossier/index paths because the TTKS navigation index shares the B1 row. The old40-profile status cell is corrected to39profile dossiers plus a navigation index, rather than counting a router as another source profile. The five books and LOTM/COI remain distinct source/era contracts; the bare mirror-family label is not another novel. P10's17-profile marker census is static coverage, not source authentication. A source-preserving generator does not clone a reserved canonical object by a random noun swap; an actual source-supported copying/creation mechanism is a different operation and remains possible. Geometry/law mutation exclusions belong to these selected authoring packets, not a universal prohibition on every world or power.

Every profile still needs its actual selected world, era, actor means, custody and native reader. A late hash inventory cannot establish an initial atomic snapshot, and proposed branch/port/schema identifiers are not live ownership. No broad world-factory, new-start pool, hungry-play requirement, regional economy or further Frontier depth is selected. Existing useful palettes, named conflicts and source gaps are preserved.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B400: narrative checkpoint proposals keep their causal owners
folds.body:
The complete P12–P16 checkpoints were reviewed. Their sibling checkpoint-only and P3/P4 unmerged observations are historical, while causal quests, authored source anchors, typed episodes, observer accounts, expression and cross-life variants retain distinct useful contracts. The actual earlier live audits and later qualified PLAN/B288 remain their own proof; reading a checkpoint does not exercise their source or authenticate every referenced book/scene.

A typed consequential episode can preserve a real cause without retaining every line of prose. An actor's account/edition and an objective event differ; a readable chronicle and a lossy biography are not a playable branch save. P14's640KiB active-instance figure was an unmeasured planning budget, not a browser quota or fictional world cap. Narration, generated grammar, dialogue voice and an authoring compiler can project a committed operation without creating new resource, RNG, progression or grant authority. Runtime LLM options remain unselected; no model request or source acquisition follows.

Loop/reset, ending/succession, another self, ordinary departure, dream/observation and player authorship are different operations with actual carriers and clocks. A source-qualified unusual power may really remove a dependency; no artificial drawback or generic reset follows from an ending label. Preserve source conflicts and unknown values instead of filling them from a plot template. Current developer-route policy is distinct from ordinary/alternative lives. No narrative generator, save archive, new schema, hidden truth or autoplay routine was implemented, and optional human taste review does not block continued authorized work under AD42.
